name: home
instructions: This is a personal home assistant. You can check the house and the owner's calendars, change things in the house, and send messages to a few named people. It can't read email, browse the web, or reach anyone else. Prefer the read-only tools for questions.

tools.name: house_status
tools.title: House status
tools.description: Current state of the house: lights on, open covers, thermostat, active media players. Read-only.

tools.name: calendar
tools.title: Calendar
tools.description: Events on the owner's calendars for a range or dates. Read-only.

tools.name: control_house
tools.title: Change something in the house
tools.description: Ask the house agent to change something: lights, TVs, fans, thermostat, covers. Every action is checked by its guard.

ask.prompt:
The owner asked, through an outside assistant, for this change in the house. Do it with the guarded Home Assistant actions only; if it isn't a change to the house, do nothing and say so.

Request: {request}

tools.name: send_message
tools.title: Send a message
tools.description: Send a message from the assistant to one of the configured destinations.
